preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array must be between 1 and 2,000,000.
The number of coupons must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= qi <= 100000 and 1 <= wi <= 100000 for qi, wi in coupons)
preconditions.description: Each coupon must have distinct qi and wi values within the range of 1 to 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum amount of money Sereja can pay, represented as a string.
